title: Sahaj Mile
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Sahaj Mile" where he says, today every person has become competitive and wants to achieve something, but the problem arises when he is ready to do anything to achieve it.

title: Nirbal Ko Na
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Nirbal Ko Na" where he says that you should not oppress somebody weak thinking that person cannot do you any harm. Remember a weak person's curse can cause great harm.

title: Chinta Aisi Dakini
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Chinta Aisi Dakini" where he says that the state of mind being anxious is like a fire in the ocean, neither smoke comes out of it nor is it visible to anyone.

title: Nahaye Dohye Kya
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Kabir's doha "Nahaye Dohye Kya" and explains how adversities toughen a person's character from outside but the real character and relevance is to stay pure and not have bitter thoughts.

title: Jin Khoja Tin
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Jin Khoja Tin" where he says if you try hard enough, then you will definitely find your way. One must never give up trying as only then he can find success.

title: Shram Hi Hota Hai
desc: Javed Akhtar elucidates on Kabir's doha "Shram Hi Hota Hai". He says hard work is very important & if you are patient enough, the world will reward you well & bless you with abundance.

title: Dosh Paraye
desc: Javed Akhtar explains through Kabir's doha "Dosh Paraye" how gossiping can harm relationships. One must look at one's own flaws & then point out others, he says try to improve yourself first.

title: Raat Gavaayai
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Raat Gavaayai" where he says, life is like a precious diamond that is made up of time, therefore we should make good use of our time to lead a successful life.

title: Thothe Badar
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Thothe Badar" where he says it's not difficult to digest success in life, but it's very difficult to accept failure after you have failed multiple times.

title: Guru Kumbhar
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Guru Kumbhar" where he says, just how a potter slowly moulds clay to make a pot, in the same way a teacher also moulds his/her student to survive in this world.

title: Jo Rahim Uttam Prakrit
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the importance of having a strong character and dignity and explains this in a poignant analogy through Rahim's Doha "Jo Rahim Uttam Prakrit".

title: Uttam Vidya
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrind's doha "Uttam Vidya" where he says, even if gold is lying in a dirty place, no one leaves it, similarly knowledge, even if possessed by a lowly person, should be accepted.

title: Jaati Na Poocho
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Jaati Na Poocho" where he says, just as the value of a sword is judged on the basis of its edge and not on sheath, in the same way knowledge should be given priority over caste.

title: Rahiman Kathin
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Kathin" where he says, anxiety is worse than a pyre. The pyre burns the dead, while worry keeps burning the living.

title: Thour Chhute
desc: Moving away from our roots is a popular sentiment today. Javed Akhtar through Vrind's doha "Thour Chhute" says that as much as a person knows English, he must also know his mother tongue.

title: Sahaj Mile
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Sahaj Mile" where he says, today every person has become competitive and wants to achieve something, but the problem arises when he is ready to do anything to achieve it.

title: Shabd Samahare Boliye
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Shabd Samahare Boliye" where he says some words can make a relation strong, but the same words in a rude tone can break the relation. Tone plays an important role.

title: Jaa Ghat Prem
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about Kabir's doha "Jaa Ghat Prem" & explains how love & emotional bond is important for anyone to grow & evolve. He says humans without love is equivalent to a lifeless state.

title: Prem Na Baari
desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabir's doha "Prem Na Baari" where he says that love does not grow in the fields & is neither sold in the market. One who wants love has to give up his anger, lust, desire, fear.
